features.description: Saturn is a trading terminal that lives in Telegram. These are the engines behind it — each one a named capability inside the product, not a marketing category.
features.f1.name: Pasted Contracts
features.f1.body: Paste any CA into chat and Saturn returns a full trading panel: live price and 24h change, liquidity, market cap, top-holder distribution, honeypot / mint / freeze checks, and direct buy/sell.
features.f2.name: Auto Snipe
features.f2.body: Queue contracts or deployer wallets and fire at liquidity-add. Modes: Method ID (fires on addLiquidity), liquidity threshold, or wallet copy.
features.f3.name: Limit Orders
features.f3.body: Trigger on exact price, market-cap crossing, multiplier (2x / 5x / 10x), or trailing stop.
features.f4.name: DCA Orders
features.f4.body: Dollar-cost average into any token with fixed-amount recurring buys on a custom interval. Pause or resume any time.
features.f5.name: Copy Trade
features.f5.body: Mirror any wallet with a configurable copy %, max buy size, blacklist and stop conditions.
features.f6.name: Whale Alerts
features.f6.body: Get pinged the moment a tracked or known whale wallet buys or sells, with the swap size and route surfaced instantly.
features.f7.name: Trade Monitor & Positions
features.f7.body: A real-time portfolio engine with multi-wallet parallel execution — select one, several, or all wallets — plus live PnL, average entry and USD value per holding.
features.f8.name: MEV Protection
features.f8.body: Private-bundle routing — Jito on Solana, Flashbots on EVM — to block sandwich attacks. Toggleable per chain.
features.f9.name: Multi-Wallet
features.f9.body: Run up to 10 wallets per chain — generate fresh in-bot or import via private key — and select any combination for parallel execution on one trade.
features.f10.name: Discover
features.f10.body: Surface trending tokens, fresh launches and high-volume pairs across every routed DEX, ranked by real-time momentum.
features.f11.name: Global Settings
features.f11.body: Quick-buy presets, sell % presets, separate buy and sell slippage, Solana priority lamports, EVM gas tip — configured per chain.
features.f12.name: Bridge
features.f12.body: Move capital cross-chain without leaving Telegram, with cheapest-route aggregation.

gettingStarted.description: No accounts department, no onboarding calls. Four steps and you're live on-chain.
gettingStarted.s1.title: Open the bot
gettingStarted.s1.body: Start Saturn on Telegram or open the web dashboard. No sign-up, no KYC, no email required to trade.
gettingStarted.s2.title: Fund a wallet
gettingStarted.s2.body: Generate or import up to 10 wallets per chain. Keys are encrypted and stay with your account — never pooled or held.
gettingStarted.s3.title: Set your presets
gettingStarted.s3.body: Buy amounts, slippage, gas tips, MEV protection and auto-sell multipliers — configure once per chain, reuse forever.
gettingStarted.s4.title: Trade & automate
gettingStarted.s4.body: Paste a contract, arm a sniper, mirror a whale, or let limit and DCA orders run while Telegram is closed.

faq.description: Grouped by what you're actually trying to do. Every answer reflects what the bots ship today.
faq.g1.label: Getting started
faq.g1.q1: Do I need to sign up or complete KYC?
faq.g1.a1: No KYC, ever. The Telegram bot needs zero sign-up — open @Saturnsolbot (Solana), @Saturnethbot (Ethereum and EVM) or the BSC bot and your account is created on the first message. The web dashboard offers optional account creation via Telegram Connect, email, magic link, or link code — but it's not required to start trading. Both paths are non-custodial.
faq.g1.q2: How many wallets can I run?
faq.g1.a2: Up to 10 per chain. Generate them in-bot or import via private key, then select one, several or all of them for parallel execution on a single trade.
faq.g1.a3: Yes — app.saturnbots.org runs the same account, wallets and positions engine as the bots, with Trade Monitor, Positions and Wallets on a full screen.
faq.g2.label: Execution engines
faq.g2.a1: Queue a contract address or a deployer wallet. It fires at liquidity-add, in one of three modes: Method ID (on addLiquidity), liquidity threshold, or wallet copy.
faq.g2.q2: What triggers can Limit Orders use?
faq.g2.a2: Exact price, market-cap crossing, multiplier (2x / 5x / 10x), or trailing stop.
faq.g2.a3: Mirror any wallet you track. Set a fixed size or a percentage of the leader's trade, and route the copy through your selected wallets.
faq.g3.label: Chains & security
faq.g3.a1: Solana is in production across Raydium, Pump.fun, Meteora and Orca. Ethereum is in production across the EVM networks — Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon. BSC is live across PancakeSwap and the top BNB Chain DEXes. Tron is live across SunSwap. Other chains are coming soon.
faq.g3.a2: MEV protection routes orders through private bundles — Jito on Solana, Flashbots on EVM. Toggle it per chain in Global Settings.
faq.g3.a3: No. Saturn is non-custodial — wallets belong to you, keys stay with your account, and nothing is pooled or held by the platform.
faq.g4.label: Fees & referrals
faq.g4.q1: What does the referral program pay?
faq.g4.a1: Five tiers, based on referral count: Bronze 0.5%, Silver 0.75% at 5 refs, Gold 1.0% at 15, Platinum 1.5% at 30 and Diamond 2.0% at 50+. Payouts are automatic and on-chain.
faq.g4.a2: docs.saturnbots.org covers setup guides, command references, API docs and troubleshooting for every Saturn bot.
